title: RDEP
summary: Public paper-PDF mirror for RDEP: the site-served paper PDF that carries the canonical architecture, analysis, evaluation, and reproducibility appendix. Internal paper sources and standalone benchmark artifacts are not mirrored here.
notes: This public receipt mirrors only the paper PDF exposed on the site; it does not enumerate the internal paper source tree or standalone benchmark artifacts.

Standalone benchmark JSONs and production training logs are not currently served as public site assets and are therefore not listed as mirrored artifacts.
